purpose: MITRE ATT&CK oriented analytics derived from ML event/session output without fabricating MITRE values.

timestamp.behavior: MITRE activity records require a valid timestamp.

session_id.behavior: Missing or empty session_id must remain missing and must not be fabricated.

mitre_technique.behavior: MITRE technique may be NULL or empty. Empty values must not be fabricated into a technique category.

attack_type.behavior: Attack type may be NULL or empty.

attack_stage.behavior: Attack stage may be NULL or empty.

output.behavior: Output analytics must only contain dimensions and relationships supported by valid source values. Empty source MITRE fields must not be converted into fabricated MITRE values.

transformation_rules: MITRE_ANALYTICS must be read-only with respect to source data.
MITRE_ANALYTICS must not modify source records.
MITRE_ANALYTICS must not generate ML features.
MITRE_ANALYTICS must not alter production cluster assignments.
MITRE_ANALYTICS must not fabricate MITRE enrichment.
Only events/sessions with a valid, non-empty MITRE field contribute to the technique distribution.

mitre_tactics_mapping.rule: Tactic is derived from technique using the official MITRE mapping. Unknown techniques have tactic=null.
